ModMetaData.name: Milira: Wings of Democracy - Float Menu Fix
ModMetaData.author: Vorsel
ModMetaData.description:
【中文说明】
【问题发现】 在一个启用了数百个 Mod 的存档中逐项排查后，我发现 Milira Race 和 Milira: Wings of Democracy 都会让地图右键菜单在开启期间持续占用较多性能。两个问题是在同一轮排查中发现的，但来自不同 Mod、对应不同代码路径，因此分别制作了两个独立的 Fix Mod。
随后使用 Codex 检查 RimWorld 1.6 的 FloatMenu 调用链、XML Def 和编译后的程序集，并通过 A/B 测试确认修复效果。
【主要修复】
1. 无关目标触发太阳晶体容器检查 PLAMilira_EmptySolarCrystalContainer 会扫描地图并寻找储存位置，即使右键的是物品架、地面或 Milira Race 的日凌聚光塔。
修复：只有日凌晶辐射催化器可以进入这套逻辑。预期可消除 Wings 对无关右键目标造成的持续开销。
2. PLAMilira_PoisonFood 重复执行同一检查 当前 1.6 Def 将它配置为与太阳晶体容器相同的 worker，因此右键菜单会重复生成相同检查和操作。
修复：仅在右键菜单中跳过这一重复项，不修改原 Mod 的 Def 或普通 AI 扫描。
3. 日凌晶辐射催化器重复搜索储存位置 催化器有产物时，菜单会反复执行两次储存位置搜索。
修复：短期缓存最终菜单结果。预期可降低菜单保持开启时的持续耗时，日凌晶提取功能保持不变。
4. 重复的补充燃料按钮 未征召小人会同时看到 rearming 和补充燃料；两者对催化器使用相同的补燃料 JobDriver。
修复：未征召时隐藏重复的 rearming 选项；征召时仍保留它，以免失去原 Mod 提供的征召补充能力。
【本机测试，仅供参考】 • 日凌聚光塔：约 90–100 FPS → 约 135–140 FPS • 日凌晶辐射催化器：修复后约 135–140 FPS，提取功能测试正常
以上结果来自本机存档和 MSI Afterburner，仅供参考。
【兼容性与存档】 补丁通过 Harmony 运行，只调整右键菜单检查，不修改 Wings of Democracy 原文件、普通 AI 工作扫描或存档数据。理论上可以中途加入或移除；更改后请完整重启游戏，并正常备份重要存档。
【开发说明】 问题定位、调用链调查和补丁代码由 Codex 协助完成；性能数据与功能验证由我在游戏内实际测试。
【English Description】
【Issue】 While continuing to investigate float-menu slowdowns in a setup with several hundred mods, I found that Milira: Wings of Democracy repeatedly ran its WorkGiver checks for ordinary storage and unrelated buildings. Logs identified the solar-crystal container check and a duplicated WorkGiver configuration as the main costs.
Codex was used to inspect the RimWorld 1.6 FloatMenu call chain, XML Defs, and compiled assembly. The changes were then verified through in-game A/B testing.
【Main fixes】
1. Solar-crystal container checks on unrelated targets PLAMilira_EmptySolarCrystalContainer could scan the map and search for storage even when the clicked target was storage, a cell, or Milira Race's Solar Fuel tower.
Fix: only the Radiation Catalyzer may enter this logic. This is expected to remove Wings-related sustained cost from unrelated float menus.
2. Duplicate PLAMilira_PoisonFood check In the current 1.6 Defs it uses the same worker as the solar-crystal container, causing the same menu check and action to be processed twice.
Fix: the duplicate is skipped only during float-menu generation. Original Defs and normal AI scans are not modified.
3. Repeated storage searches for the Radiation Catalyzer When output was available, menu validation repeatedly performed two storage searches.
Fix: the final menu result is briefly cached. Solar Crystal extraction remains unchanged.
4. Duplicate refueling options Undrafted pawns could receive both rearming and refuel options, which use the same refueling JobDriver for this building.
Fix: the duplicate rearming option is hidden while undrafted. It remains available while drafted so the original drafted-refueling capability is preserved.
【Local test results — reference only】 • Milira Race Solar Fuel tower: about 90–100 FPS → about 135–140 FPS • Radiation Catalyzer: about 135–140 FPS after the fix; extraction tested successfully
These MSI Afterburner results are from one local setup and are provided only as a reference.
【Compatibility】 This Harmony patch only adjusts float-menu checks. It does not modify Wings of Democracy files, normal AI work scans, or save data. It should be safe in theory to add or remove mid-save; fully restart the game after changing the mod list and keep normal backups.
【Development】 Codex assisted with call-chain investigation and implementation. Performance measurements and gameplay validation were performed in game by the author.
